name: 92227 · Brawley, CA
findings: ZIP 92227 (Brawley) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92227 (Brawley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92227 (Brawley) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
